title: The run-down Dreamland club and Bill Bottoms
summary: The Dreamland was a rundown club where bands were hardly paid, in contrast to its heyday under Bill Bottoms.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and the Prohibition-era clubs

blocks.x: What -- what was the Dreamland like?
Dreamland was a run down night club.

It had been a very popular place, it had run down during the time I was there, there was no business, nobody was getting paid. Bands wasn't getting paid, but we would get $5.00 or $10.00 every other night, or something. To tide us over to give the musicians, but we weren't really getting paid at all. It was rundown. Before that it was run by a fellow named Bill Bottoms.
That was when the Dreamland was really doing well.
Well Bill Bottoms was a very dapper fellow?
